# Assistants mobile · Mel design handoff

> Mel is the AI copilot for real estate agents (RadiusAgent). This site is the mobile design handoff: every screen as static HTML + PNG, markdown specs with the on-screen copy, and the Radius Mobile design system (tokens, components, rules). Build native iOS (SwiftUI) and Android (Jetpack Compose) from these; use tokens.json values, not hex from screenshots.

## Specs (start here)
- [Assistants mobile spec](/spec/assistants.md): chat, onboarding, CRM, Marketing, Campaign, Client Experience, SMS/email/WhatsApp flows
- [Mel voice mode spec](/spec/voice.md): voice screens, states, minimised bubble, iOS background states
- [Mel brand guidelines spec](/spec/brand.md)

## Design system
- [README](/design-system/README.md): how to use the system
- [Decisions](/design-system/01-decisions.md): approved decisions and dates
- [Color](/design-system/04-color.md), [Typography](/design-system/05-typography.md), [Layout](/design-system/06-layout.md), [Mel mark](/design-system/08-mel.md), [Screens](/design-system/10-screens.md), [Native handoff](/design-system/14-native-handoff.md), [iOS background](/design-system/16-ios-background.md)
- [tokens.json](/design-system/tokens.json): all tokens, light and dark values
- [bundle.css](/design-system/components/bundle.css): reference CSS
